environment.description: Same service deployed on EKS with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' level via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The container image uses a distroless base with no shell binaries present. The PostgreSQL connection uses role 'app_tenant_svc' which has RLS policies active on all tables with policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON task_audit USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). Additionally, the node runs a custom seccomp profile (deployed via SecurityOperator CRD) that blocks execve/execveat syscalls for the container's cgroup, and a NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the RDS endpoint on port 5432 and the internal DNS resolver.

config.seccomp_profile: custom profile blocking execve(2) and execveat(2) for container cgroup via SecurityOperator CRD
config.network_policy: egress limited to RDS:5432 and kube-dns:53 only
config.pod_security: restricted PSS (no privilege escalation, non-root, read-only rootfs)
